structured.answer: With 500 ₪ a month at the page's assumed 7% a year, after 8 years about 68,853 ₪ would be left in my hands with no tax. After 4 years the page shows 25,725 ₪, but it says that for the self-employed it doesn't yet calculate withdrawals before 6 years and that tax would be taken, so that's a rough figure before tax.
